Messages.Author: vermillian
Messages.Body:
My worhsipful and great prince has allowed me to ask of the mighty
scroll of newsgroup a few questions, as long as I don't embarass
him... And before I ask the first question, I already did a quick
little search on google for the answer to the first one to no avail...

1.) Nepata's gotta' hunt, she's low on blood. Oh NO! I've been blocked
by Meshenka! Oh, but he's a kind Meshenka, and S:CE for me with Meld
with the Land, so I don't have to (but I do so anyway to cycle cards
for bleed modifiers... bwahaha). Now I'm untapped, and with no
blood...
a) May I still hunt (no repeat actions thing and what not...)?
b) If I can't hunt, may I do something else (like... oh... Enchant
Kindred).

2.) So... Some misc. vampiric minion must hunt... but before I do
that, may I tap the Hidelberg Castle to give him blood from another
minion? Sure, I can't tap it in the middle of an action, but I'm not
in the middle of an action... as I'm the acting minion, I get to
choose the order of things that happen simultaneously... right?

3.) [not really a question...] Just to get it straight... Boy Toy
Kindred Spirits... Zebulon masks... oh wait, Zeb can't because he
doesn't have dementation... so Zeb can't play mask... right?

4.) [as above] My Black Magician tries to steal a discipline. Zeb
takes over with Mask... oh, wait... no he doesn't... Zeb can't play a
mask... right?

5.) Inferior Revelations (much better than Superior rev.)... I look at
my prey's hand... then I choose a card to get axed.

a) Can I tap Slaughter House while looking at it, and THEN cause a
card to get axed from his hand?

b) Does he replace the card he discards while I'm still looking at his
hand (that is... do I get to see the card he draws to replace the one
I axed)?

um... that's all for now...

~SV

Not if you're using the NRA rule. See the NRA rule.

> b) If I can't hunt, may I do something else (like... oh... Enchant

No. [6]

> 2.) So... Some misc. vampiric minion must hunt... but before I do

> minion? Sure, I can't tap it in the middle of an action, but I'm not
> in the middle of an action... as I'm the acting minion, I get to
> choose the order of things that happen simultaneously... right?

Yes.

> 3.) [not really a question...] Just to get it straight... Boy Toy
> Kindred Spirits... Zebulon masks... oh wait, Zeb can't because he
> doesn't have dementation... so Zeb can't play mask... right?

Right. See the online rulings for Mask.

> 4.) [as above] My Black Magician tries to steal a discipline. Zeb
> takes over with Mask... oh, wait... no he doesn't... Zeb can't play a
> mask... right?

Right, again per the ruling.

> 5.) Inferior Revelations (much better than Superior rev.)... I look at
> my prey's hand... then I choose a card to get axed.
>
> a) Can I tap Slaughter House while looking at it, and THEN cause a
> card to get axed from his hand?

No.

> b) Does he replace the card he discards while I'm still looking at his
> hand (that is... do I get to see the card he draws to replace the one
> I axed)?

Moot.

Messages.Author: Matt Latham
Messages.Body:

news:3C220478...@white-wolf.com...
> vermillian wrote:

> > b) Does he replace the card he discards while I'm still looking at his
> > hand (that is... do I get to see the card he draws to replace the one
> > I axed)?
>
> Moot.
>

I don't think it's moot. What I believe he is asking is "Inferior
Revelations lets me look at his hand and force a discard. Do I get to see
what card he replaces the discard with before I lose the ability to look at
his hand?"

I think the b) question is separate from the a) question.

I may be wrong though.

Matt
